explanation: Requested a 5-point scan of cos(theta*) from -1 to +1 at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg for the eta channel: cos(theta*) = -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1. Preflight check flagged the two endpoints (cos(theta*) = -1 and +1) as FAIL: EXCLURAD cannot evaluate exactly at the forward/backward poles. Applied the validated convention of clamping the endpoints to +/-0.999 (all interior points were unaffected). Re-ran preflight and all 5 points passed; generated the input file accordingly.
